positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: CoreAVI architects safety critical graphics and compute solutions supporting safe autonomy, machine vision, AI and visualization applications in the automotive, unmanned vehicle and industrial IoT markets, as well as commercial and military avionics systems. We are people innovating a safe and secure autonomous world. Come learn more at www.coreavi.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior Stf
positions.description: Software engineering professional with 20 years of experience. Have been with Lockheed Martin Aeronautics for 17 years, mostly on assignment with the F-35 Lightning program. Currently working with the Mission Systems DevOps team using agile processes for integration and test automation development of the F-35 Mission Systems software. Previous experience includes the primary weapons model integrator for the F-35 simulator. I also worked with the Core Processing Software team mostly as a project lead for the sensor supplier middleware product. I also have experience designing the fibre channel communication software interface for Mission Systems. Past non-Lockheed work experience involves designing and developing applications to test and diagnose electronics in the semiconductor technology sector.  Have project leadership experience involving cross-functional cooperation of a small group of peers on a time sensitive schedule.  Also, have demonstrated effective communication and evaluation skills.
